content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 12th / +2 pass Age limit: 18 to 45 years (as on 1 October 2022) Other conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of the concerned Anganwadi service area. Must be able to read and write Odia language.

content_sections.heading: How Will WCD Odisha Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Application review Additional weightage for SC/ST/PH/destitute/widow candidates as per government rules

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Caste certificate Resident certificate issued within 4 years by Tehsildar Mark sheets and certificates of educational qualifications Age proof certificate (Matric certificate) Widow certificate / destitute certificate / physically handicapped certificate if applicable Passport size photo and signature

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Applicants must apply online via http://engagement-awc.odisha.gov.in using public login. Upload required documents such as caste certificate, residence certificate, mark sheets, and certificates. Apply on or before 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 October 2026. Applications opened on 14 October 2022.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies for Anganwadi Sahayika.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 45 years (as on 1 October 2022).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium-based as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Must have passed 12th / +2 pass.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be a permanent resident of the concerned Anganwadi service area. Must be able to read and write Odia language.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application review. Additional weightage for SC/ST/PH/destitute/widow candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tirtol.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Caste certificate; Resident certificate issued within 4 years by Tehsildar; Mark sheets and certificates of educational qualifications; Age proof certificate (Matric certificate); Widow certificate / destitute certificate / physically handicapped certificate if applicable; Passport size photo and signature.
